title: Fix module resolution and Vite bundling for browser builds
body:
TypeScript compilation and Vite bundling failed when importing `objectstack.config.ts` from example packages. Three issues identified:

1. Example packages didn't export their config files in `package.json`
2. Import used wrong package name: `@objectstack/example-todo` → `@example/app-todo`
3. Node.js modules (`module`, `crypto`) imported at top level in `@objectstack/core` caused Vite bundling failures

## Changes

**Package exports** - Added `exports`, `main`, and `types` fields to:
- `@example/app-todo/package.json`
- `@example/app-crm/package.json`  
- `@example/plugin-bi/package.json`

```json
{
  "main": "./objectstack.config.ts",
  "types": "./objectstack.config.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": "./objectstack.config.ts",
    "./objectstack.config": "./objectstack.config.ts"
  }
}
```

**Import path** - Fixed in `examples/app-react-crud/src/mocks/browser.ts`:
```typescript
- import todoConfig from '@objectstack/example-todo/objectstack.config';
+ import todoConfig from '@example/app-todo/objectstack.config';
```

**Universal library bundling** - Fixed Node.js module imports in `@objectstack/core`:
- `packages/core/src/logger.ts` - Moved `module` import to runtime using eval for Node.js environment detection
- `packages/core/src/security/plugin-signature-verifier.ts` - Moved `crypto` import to runtime using eval

These changes prevent browser bundlers (Vite/Rollup) from attempting to include Node.js-only modules in browser bundles while maintaining full functionality in Node.js environments.

## Testing

- ✅ TypeScript compilation passes
- ✅ Vite build completes successfully
- ✅ Browser builds work correctly
- ✅ Security scan passed (0 vulnerabilities)
